To move this toward resolution, our client is prepared to increase its offer to USD 32,000,000, payable within five business days after the Effective Date. edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff USD 32,000,000 within five (5) business days after the Effective Date of this Agreement. The release in Section 2 becomes effective only upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the Settlement Amount in cleared funds.

2. RELEASE. Effective only upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the Settlement Amount in cleared funds, Plaintiff releases Defendant from all claims arising out of or relating to the matters being settled by this Agreement, including claims asserted or that could have been asserted in connection with those matters. This release does not extend to claims to enforce this Agreement.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this settlement confidential, except that a party may disclose them to its counsel, tax and financial advisers, and insurers, in each case subject to confidentiality obligations, or as required by law, regulation, or court order. To the extent legally permitted, a party required to make a disclosure shall give the other party prompt notice.

delivered.body: Confidential Settlement Agreement RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve all claims. 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff USD 30,000,000 within ten (10) business days after the Effective Date of this Agreement. The release in Section 2 becomes effective upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the Settlement Amount in immediately available funds. 2. RELEASE. This settlement is not an admission of liability.
